author: Brian Bennewitz
name: Bennewitz.Ninja NuGet package
//sourceName: -n takes the UNPREFIXED stem, e.g. -n Widget, because assembly names stay unprefixed in
this family while package ids carry Bennewitz.Ninja. One sourceName cannot produce both:
since Directory.Build.props already prepends the prefix. So the prefixed id is DERIVED below.

RepoOwner.description: GitHub account or organisation the generated repository lives under.

Analyzer.description: A Roslyn analyzer package instead of a library: netstandard2.0, packed under analyzers/dotnet/cs, with a sample rule to replace and the analyzer's guard tests.

//RulePrefix: BN and the product's initials, the family's scheme: BNCQ for CodeQuality. Every rule's ID
starts with it, and a consumer's suppressions name those IDs, so it never changes after the
first release. BNXX is visibly not a choice; the README's rules table shows it until one is made.

RulePrefix.description: With --analyzer: the prefix of every rule's ID, BN and the product's initials, e.g. BNCQ. It never changes after the first release.

symbols.//RulePrefixLower: The README's anchors: a heading's anchor is its text in lower case.
